create_CaseResult: create a CaseResult namedtuple to store a single test case result with id, name, kind, and traceback
create_CaseResult_updated: create an updated copy of a CaseResult by changing its kind, stdout, or stderr fields
build_AugmentedResult: build an AugmentedResult subclass of unittest.TestResult that tracks stdout and stderr per test case
summarize_summary: summarize an AugmentedResult object into a human-readable string with test counts, tracebacks, and notes
build_jenkins_junit_xml: build a Jenkins-compatible JUnit XML ElementTree from an AugmentedResult containing test case outcomes
